desc:
🏖️ Be a lifeguard on a busy beach! Spot swimmers in trouble, paddle out on your rescue board and save them. Rank up to jet skis and rescue boats.

Somebody's in trouble out there. Nobody's seen them yet.

🔭 Scan the water through your binoculars for anyone drowning
💓 Revive anyone who's stopped breathing with CPR and the AED
📻 Take HQ's calls: capsized kayaks, lilos blown out to sea, kitesurfers in trouble and boats that need a tow
🚨 Big incidents for everyone on duty: a yacht capsize, a plane down in the bay, a shark among the swimmers
⛈️ Storms, heatwaves and safety flags change the whole beach
🚤 Ten ranks from trainee to head lifeguard, with vehicle unlocks at each: quad bike, dinghy, jet ski, dirt bike, truck and more
👕 Unlock new looks for your uniform and rescue board
👥 Patrol with everyone in your server, or on your own
🤝 Play with a friend for 10% more XP
📱 Play on phone, tablet, PC and console
